name: Parallel Multi-Tier Critique Loop
description: Fans out a draft to main, subagent, and local-uncensored critics across cloud-io and local-gpu queues, synthesizes feedback, and routes via a bounded decision loop.

nodes.label: Prepare Draft
nodes.promptTemplate:
Prepare or revise the technical proposal for: {{topic}}
Prior synthesis (if any): {{synthesis}}

nodes.label: Architecture Critic (Main)
nodes.promptTemplate:
Critique the architecture and correctness of this draft:
{{draft}}

nodes.label: Edge-Case Critic (Subagent)
nodes.promptTemplate:
Identify edge cases, missing tests, and failure modes in this draft:
{{draft}}

nodes.label: Red-Team Critic (Local GPU)
nodes.promptTemplate:
Provide an unfiltered red-team critique of this draft:
{{draft}}

nodes.label: Synthesize Critiques
Approve or Revise
nodes.promptTemplate:
Review the synthesis below and choose 'approve' if ready or 'revise' if another pass is needed:
{{synthesis}}

nodes.label: Finalize Proposal
